proof:
classical
obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := h_T005.2.2.1
have hc : ∀ (u : L p M) (i : Ix l),
    B.repr (u : V) i ∈ J p M (ev y v 0) := by
  intro u i
  rw [← h_T009 i, ← hB i]
  change (B.repr (u : V) i) • B i ∈ L p M
  simpa [matrixUnit, Module.Basis.coord_apply] using
    (h_T008.2.2.2 B hB i i).2 (u : V) u.property
have hs : ∀ (c : Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)),
    (∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • B i) ∈ L p M := by
  intro c
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i _
  have hi : (c i : ℂ) ∈ J p M (ev y v i.val) := by
    simpa only [h_T009 i] using (c i).property
  change (c i : ℂ) • ev y v i.val ∈ L p M at hi
  simpa only [hB i] using hi
let s : (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)) ≃ₗ[R p] L p M :=
  { toFun := fun c => ⟨∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • B i, hs c⟩
    invFun := fun u i => ⟨B.repr (u : V) i, hc u i⟩
    left_inv := by
      intro c
      funext i
      apply Subtype.ext
      change B.repr (∑ j : Ix l, (c j : ℂ) • B j) i = (c i : ℂ)
      exact congr_fun (B.repr_sum_self (fun j => (c j : ℂ))) i
    right_inv := by
      intro u
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (∑ i : Ix l, B.repr (u : V) i • B i) = (u : V)
      exact B.sum_repr (u : V)
    map_add' := by
      intro c d
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (∑ i : Ix l, ((c i : ℂ) + (d i : ℂ)) • B i) =
        (∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • B i) + ∑ i : Ix l, (d i : ℂ) • B i
      simp only [add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    map_smul' := by
      intro r c
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (∑ i : Ix l, (r • (c i : ℂ)) • B i) =
        r • (∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • B i)
      simp only [smul_assoc, Finset.smul_sum] }
refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
intro c
change (∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • B i) = ∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • ev y v i.val
simp only [hB]
statement:
∃ s : (Ix l → J p M (ev y v 0)) ≃ₗ[R p] L p M,
  ∀ c, (s c : V) = ∑ i : Ix l, (c i : ℂ) • ev y v i.val
